properties.headline: Flood Warning issued November 5 at 6:00PM MST until November 6 at 5:00AM MST by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Pueblo has issued a Flood Warning
for the following rivers in Colorado...

Arkansas River At Lamar affecting Prowers County.

* WHAT...Flooding has been reported by emergency management.

* WHERE...Arkansas River at Lamar.

* WHEN...From this afternoon to late tonight.

* IMPACTS...At 10.0 feet, The river is bankfull. Minor overbank flow
into lowlands along the river occurs near Lamar. Water flows into
low lying meadows near County Road 13.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 5:00 PM MST Thursday the stage was 8.9 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 10.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 9.6 feet
late this evening.
- Flood stage is 11.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued November 5 at 3:58PM MST until November 6 at 4:00PM MST by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding continues along the Rio Grande and low-lying areas
in and around the Conejos River confluence.

* WHERE...East Central Conejos County in south central Colorado...
West Central Costilla County in south central Colorado...
South Central Alamosa County in southeastern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 400 PM MST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Low-water
crossings are inundated with water and may not be passable. Expect
many areas of slow moving or standing water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 356 PM MST, Flood waters continue to move downstream along the
Rio Grande, Conejos River and other tributaries. Flooding and
inundation of low-lying areas continues in the warned area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Alamosa East and Lasauses.
- http://www.water.noaa.gov
properties.areaDesc: Alamosa, CO; Conejos, CO; Costilla, CO

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued November 5 at 10:26AM MST until November 7 at 2:00AM MST by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Colorado...

Purgatoire River Near Las Animas affecting Bent County.

For the Purgatoire River...including Las Animas...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Purgatoire River near Las Animas.

* WHEN...Until late Friday night.

* IMPACTS...At 9.0 feet, Minor Flood. Minor agricultural flooding
occurs into low lying areas along the river.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:15 AM MST Thursday the stage was 9.6 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 9:15 AM MST Thursday was 9.6 feet.
- Forecast...The river will fall to 9.3 feet late this morning. It
will then rise to 10.3 feet late this evening. It will fall below
flood stage early tomorrow afternoon to 2.9 feet Monday afternoon
then rise again.
- Flood stage is 9.0 feet.
- http://www.water.noaa.gov

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued November 5 at 10:23AM MST until November 6 at 2:00AM MST by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Rio Grande at Alamosa.

* IMPACTS...At 9.0 feet, Minor flooding. Minor agricultural flooding

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
